lead: A backend flag in `nvs-codegen` is pinned by a source grep, not by a symbol, so a refactor can unpin a memory-safety policy while every test stays green.
body: `crates/nvs-codegen/tests/backend_policy.rs` reads `crates/nvs-codegen/src/lib.rs` as text and asserts the literal `("enable_probestack", "true")`, so respelling the tuple or splitting the list per backend silently drops the stack-clash guarantee. Grep that test for the flag before touching the list.
